description: The full content of one public plan: description, equipment, cues, and every step with setup, instructions, success/failure criteria, set size and the rule for moving on, plus the push/drop/stick execution rules. Pass the `plan` ref from search_plans or list_plans. Link the user to the returned `url`; plan text may be quoted with attribution to its `author`.

plan.description: The `plan` ref from search_plans or list_plans: a slug (library plan) or "handle/slug".

name: get_plan
title: Read a training plan
